limits: This was a diagnostic GM-spawned encounter in an isolated emulator, not direct evidence of final-live server damage formula, hit chance, creature HP or progression rewards.

The game trace records the method name, not packet arguments; the client bytecode and F input link the calls to alternate melee, but this run does not independently record isAltAction or the numeric damage of each hit.

The isolated DLL is the prior rifle-melee build (sha256 dd22df...), not live image 20260922c. Empty-magazine and jam behavior are verified by focused tests against the new DLL, not by this client run.
The exact shutdown client revision remains unverified; 1.16.5.0 is the current compatibility requirement.
